capabilities: Build checkbox tracks and colored bars
Toggle condition labels on and off
extras: Interface follows Obsidian's language (English or Italian); works in Reading view and Live Preview on desktop and mobile; ships llms.txt so AI assistants can generate compatible sheets; pre-release builds available through BRAT; undo history is in-memory and cleared when Obsidian closes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep interactive, clickable character-sheet trackers that stay editable, searchable plain text.

relations.evidence: add progressify/ttrpg-sheet-kit in the BRAT plugin.

summary: Toolkit that turns YAML blocks into clickable counters, checkbox tracks, bars and multi-column layouts for tabletop RPG sheets, saved as plain text.
